description: A wrong fact corrected in conversation (Köln, then Düsseldorf), then the current value and what had been stored before. Limit: the correction is stored but the wrong value stays live next to it, and recall never supplies a replaced value. Failure means: the current probe failing is an update defect (stale value live); the earlier probe failing is the absent capability to recall an earlier value. Maintenance: on or off changes nothing; the supersession happens in a later turn of the same run and the maintenance pass runs only on the first memory turn. Kind: defect.

turns.user: Das war falsch. Ich arbeite in Düsseldorf.

probes.question: Was hattest du vorher darüber gespeichert, wo ich arbeite?
